text:
Newsletter launch day. Every click on a short link hit Postgres.

Connection pool gone, redirect p99 over a second — and we were barely creating new links. Read-heavy traffic through a write-shaped schema.

New case study: requirements, napkin math (100:1 reads), base62 codes, cache-aside on redirects, and the mistakes I made before the unique index on short_code.
